 Dan Quinn: Opportunity for Van Jefferson and Jaden Bradley vs Rams
 Dan Quinn talks about injuries, Myles Garrett, Rams defense
 by Scott Jennings Nov 6, 2026, 6:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Dan Quinn answered questions after the Washington Commanders held their last full practice of the week on Friday. The team is preparing to host the Los Angeles Rams at Northwest Stadium Sunday afternoon. They’re doing that with only two healthy wide receivers who have actually caught passes from Jayden Daniels this season. Treylon Burks has been dealing with a foot injury that last few weeks and hasn’t practiced this week after leading the team in receiving yards vs Philadelphia in Week 8. Dyami Brown suffered a calf injury in practice on Thursday that GM Adam Peters said “didn’t look great” this morning. Quinn said nobody is ruled out yet, and they will make those determinations, and any related roster moves, over the next two days.

 Uh-oh: Rams’ Myles Garrett reportedly on track to play Commanders in NFL Week 9

 That leaves Stefon Diggs and Antonio Williams on the field today. The team has options with Luke McCaffrey waiting for his first catch of the season. They also signed veteran Van Jefferson from the practice squad after Terry McLaurin’s season-ending knee injury. Quinn was said undrafted rookie Jaden Bradley, who will likely be elevated Sunday, leads the team’s scout team and he’s shown growth this year.
 The Rams are likely getting future Hall of Fame DE Myles Garrett back this week after he was placed on IR after surgery from a Week 1 knee injury. Quinn said the Rams defense can get pressure with four linemen, and Garrett’s return helps them. He called him a complete player who’s long, and bigger than you think. David Blough was asked about defending Aaron Donald yesterday, and mentioned the other pass rushers the Rams have that also need to be accounted for on every play.
